title: Criminal Liability for Unlicensed Construction on Buildings
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد والمبادئ القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Requirement of prior license for all floors
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that a license for superstructure addition (ترخيص التعلية) requires that all floors of the building were constructed under a prior license. FAIL if the note does not state that all floors must have been built under a prior license as a condition for issuing a superstructure addition license.

criteria.title: Unlicensed construction is a criminal offense
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that constructing the third floor without a license constitutes a criminal offense (جريمة جنائية) punishable by law. FAIL if the note does not state that constructing the third floor without a license is a criminal offense punishable by law.

criteria.title: Prohibition on legalizing what was illegally built
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that what was prohibited from being done may not be sought to be legitimized after it has been committed, meaning the violation (المخالفة) cannot be recognized or validated. FAIL if the note does not state that what was prohibited from being done may not be sought to be legitimized after it has been committed and that the violation cannot be recognized.

criteria.title: Compliance with building conditions does not override the rule
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the building's compliance with construction conditions and structural safety requirements does not permit granting a superstructure addition license (ترخيص التعلية). FAIL if the note does not state that compliance with construction conditions and structural safety requirements does not justify granting a superstructure addition license.

criteria.title: Recommendation for remedial legislation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the General Assembly recommended enacting legislation to address the situation of buildings constructed without a license. FAIL if the note does not state that the General Assembly recommended enacting legislation to address the situation of buildings constructed without a license.

review.notes: Verified C-001 through C-005 against Egypt's Unified Building Law (Law No. 119 of 2008, including Articles 43 and 60 and criminal penalty provisions) and State Council Fatwa jurisprudence on superstructure addition licenses and unlicensed construction.
